mapper.select: select * from sys_user order by id desc
select * from sys_user where status = #{status} order by id desc
select count(*) from sys_user where username = #{username}
select count(*) from sys_user where role_id = #{roleId}
mapper.insert: insert into sys_user (username, password, nickname, role_id, status, created_at) values (#{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{roleId}, #{status}, now())
mapper.update: update sys_user set status = #{status}, reject_reason = #{reason}, approved_at = if(#{status} = 'ACTIVE', now(), approved_at) where id = #{id}
update sys_user set role_id = #{roleId} where id = #{id}
update sys_user set nickname = #{nickname} where id = #{id}
update sys_user set password = #{password} where id = #{id}
update sys_user set last_login_at = now() where id = #{id}
